test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

He said, "Oh, how I would have loved to visit Kashmir this year."

options.text: He exclaimed that he would have loved to visit Kashmir that year.
He exclaimed that how he would have loved to visit Kashmir that year.
He exclaimed how I would have loved to visit Kashmir this year.
He said that he will have loved to visit Kashmir this year.

solution:
The correct answer is: **He exclaimed that he would have really loved to visit Kashmir that year.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• In **Exclamatory **sentences that express grief, sorrow, happiness, and applause, the **Interjections are removed** and the sentence is changed to an **assertive **sentence.
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'exclaimed'
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with '**that**' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
• The Subjective personal pronoun 'I' becomes 'He' in the indirect part.
 
• **This year **becomes That year in the indirect part.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

The indirect sentence is: *He exclaimed that he would have really loved to visit Kashmir that year.*
